business_summary: Village Super Market, Inc. engages in the operation of a chain of supermarkets in the United States. The company offers grocery, meat, produce, dairy, deli, seafood, prepared food, bakery, and frozen food products. It also provides non-food products, including health and beauty care, general merchandise, liquor, and pharmacy products. The company offers its products under the Wholesome Pantry, Bowl & Basket, Paperbird, and Fairway and Gourmet Garage brands. It operates its supermarkets under the ShopRite and Fairway banners, and specialty markets under the Gourmet Garage banner; and online stores through shoprite.com, fairwaymarket.com, and gourmetgarage.com websites, as well as ShopRite app, Fairway app, and Gourmet Garage app. Village Super Market, Inc. was founded in 1937 and is based in Springfield, New Jersey.
business_summary_ko: Village Super Market, Inc.는 미국에서 슈퍼마켓 체인을 운영하는 회사입니다. 이 회사는 식료품, 육류, 농산물, 유제품, 델리, 해산물, 조리 식품, 빵집 및 냉동 식품을 제공합니다. 또한 건강 및 미용 관리, 일반 상품, 주류 및 약국 제품을 포함한 비식품 제품도 제공합니다. 이 회사는 Wholesome Pantry, Bowl & Basket, Paperbird, Fairway 및 Gourmet Garage 브랜드로 제품을 제공합니다. ShopRite 및 Fairway 배너로 슈퍼마켓을 운영하고 Gourmet Garage 배너로 전문 시장을 운영합니다. shoprite.com, fairwaymarket.com, 미식가garage.com 웹사이트는 물론 ShopRite 앱, Fairway 앱, Gourmet Garage 앱을 통한 온라인 상점도 있습니다. Village Super Market, Inc.는 1937년에 설립되었으며 뉴저지 주 스프링필드에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
